levels.surface: أبو الطاهر، أحمد بن عمرو بن سرح

notes: Two sayings in one report: Ibn Mas'ud's «الشقي من شقي في بطن أمه» (read above), then Hudhayfa's account of what he heard from the Prophet after the encounter («فإني سمعت رسول الله ...»). The second saying has no chain written of its own: needs a ruling on whether it is a second route or a separate saying.
«أن عامر بن واثلة، حدثه أنه، سمع عبد الله بن مسعود» is rule 5: the named man is a link.
